operations.description: Figure S3 compares the 300 K spectrum with 350 K spectra at 0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180 and 210 min. The normalized intensity fit is PL_Intensity(t) = −0.026(t) + 1, with t in hours. This is a slight observed decline despite the main description highly stable; no absolute PL quantum yield is provided. Observation or comparison context, not an acquisition setpoint: reference temperature label = 300 K. Observation or comparison context, not an acquisition setpoint: normalized slope = -0.026 h-1.
